name: Surrender
overview: Scripture teaches that surrender involves a wholehearted trust in the Lord rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 urges believers to trust God fully. It calls for a giving of the heart and a willingness to observe God's ways, demonstrated in Proverbs 23:26. Jeremiah 10:23 reminds us that human beings cannot direct their own steps apart from God’s guidance. Ultimately, surrender is exemplified in Christ’s own prayer in Matthew 26:39 and Mark 14:35, where He submits His will to the Father’s, even in the face of great suffering. Following Jesus requires self-denial and daily commitment to take up our cross, as Luke 9:23 instructs, embodying true surrender to God’s will.
